<!-- One table = one chunk with a tbl- label and its legend in tbl-cap.
     Every table is a flextable, with the three rules of a scientific table:
     none on top, one under the header and one under the table. Quarto
     writes the caption: do not add flextable::set_caption() as well. -->

```{r}
#| label: tbl-richness
#| include: true
#| tbl-cap: "Tree species per 1-ha plot by habitat: the number of plots, the mean observed, and the richness expected by the Poisson GLM with its 95% confidence interval."
tab <- data.frame(
  Habitat  = hab_title(levels(habitat)),
  Plots    = as.integer(n_hab),
  Observed = as.numeric(tapply(richness, habitat, mean)),
  Expected = pred_rich$fit,
  CI       = sprintf("%.1f-%.1f", pred_rich$lower, pred_rich$upper),
  row.names = NULL
)
rule <- fp_border_default(style = "solid", color = "black", width = 1)

flextable(tab) |>
  set_header_labels(CI = "95% CI") |>
  align(part = "all", align = "left") |>
  hline_top(border = fp_border_default(width = 0), part = "all") |>
  hline_bottom(border = rule, part = "all") |>
  colformat_double(j = c("Observed", "Expected"), digits = 1) |>
  fit_flextable_to_page()
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-community
#| include: true
#| tbl-cap: "PERMANOVA of the composition of the tree assemblages among habitats (Bray-Curtis dissimilarities of square-root abundances, 999 permutations)."
tab_c <- data.frame(
  Term = c("Habitat", "Residual"),
  df   = tab_perm[c("habitat", "Residual"), "Df"],
  SS   = tab_perm[c("habitat", "Residual"), "SumOfSqs"],
  R2   = tab_perm[c("habitat", "Residual"), "R2"],
  F    = tab_perm[c("habitat", "Residual"), "F"],
  p    = tab_perm[c("habitat", "Residual"), "Pr(>F)"],
  row.names = NULL
)

flextable(tab_c) |>
  set_header_labels(R2 = "R²") |>
  align(part = "all", align = "left") |>
  hline_top(border = fp_border_default(width = 0), part = "all") |>
  hline_bottom(border = rule, part = "all") |>
  colformat_double(j = c("SS", "R2", "F"), digits = 2, na_str = "") |>
  colformat_double(j = "p", digits = 3, na_str = "",
                   suffix = ifelse(is.na(tab_c$p), "", stars_pval(tab_c$p))) |>
  add_footer_lines("*p ≤ 0.05, **p ≤ 0.01, ***p ≤ 0.001") |>
  fit_flextable_to_page()
```
